prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. Describe the spatial understanding this image supports: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"rgb": "..."} with 4-6 sentences.

descriptions.rgb: A narrow, uneven rocky trail runs in front of and below the camera wearer, bordered by large boulders on the left and a steep green slope or drop partly visible beyond the trail. One person is intermittently visible ahead and to the right, roughly 1–2 m away in the first four frames, wearing a dark top and light trousers; only parts of their legs and torso are visible, and a bright yellow-green item near them is partly cropped. The person moves into the right foreground in the fifth frame, approximately 0.3–0.7 m from the camera wearer, with their upper body and extended arm within the wearer's arm's reach while their lower body and backpack remain partly out of view. They face generally toward the camera wearer in the final frame, although their blurred, partially cropped face makes their exact gaze unclear. Across the strip, the camera points mostly downward and rotates to the right and slightly upward, shifting the view from nearby rocks and ground to the close person; several foreground rocks remain within about 0.5–1 m and occlude portions of the trail.
